title: Effective Mutation Rate Adaptation through Group Elite Selection
affiliation_evidence: The paper lists University of Texas at Austin affiliations.
code_license: No LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE found at the audited revision
optimization_task: Direct minimization of analytic benchmark functions
dimension_evidence: The primary audit cell is d=100; the paper also reports d=2/30/100/1000 in its appendix.
adaptive_locus: Population of Gaussian mutation rates selected by group-elite reward and meta-mutated every generation
published_targets: Table 1, d=100, std=10: 3.6 / 0.0 / 1149.7 / 943.1 / 0.0 for Ackley / Griewank / Rastrigin / Rosenbrock / Sphere
critical_blocker: The paper conflicts on dimensions and 5 versus 40 seeds; the author artifact has no dependency lock, raw camera-ready runs, license, or exact T=1000 result artifact. Its tracked table is a preliminary generation-500 table, so a discriminating published-result equivalence gate cannot be formed.
audit_note: A separate Python and MATLAB/Octave formula-validation scaffold exists under candidates/USA26-01; it is not a reproduction outcome.

title: Discrete Self-Adaptation in Competitive Coevolution for Constrained Hardware
affiliation_evidence: MIT and MIT Lincoln Laboratory affiliations are listed by GECCO.
optimization_task: Direct attacker-defender and pursuit-evasion competitive coevolution
dimension_evidence: DefendIt uses 10 resources by 40 rounds, or 400 binary decisions per player.
adaptive_locus: Per-individual mutation threshold and step-distribution threshold are inherited and mutated during evolution
published_targets: Regeneration of the published Python-versus-S1 and long-run figures from the archived run bundle
critical_blocker: The publication's native comparison requires Cerebras S1/custom C hardware, violating hard criterion 7; it also lacks a literal scalar/table result gate independent of published figures, violating criterion 8. Exact source-native validation is unavailable.
audit_note: Python replay and archived-data verification remain useful diagnostics, but this record is ineligible under the user's no-closed-hardware rule.

title: A Self-adaptive Coevolutionary Algorithm
affiliation_evidence: The author list includes MIT affiliations.
optimization_task: Direct minimax optimization on binary bilinear and DefendIt games
dimension_evidence: The reported static bilinear task uses n=300 and the dynamic task uses n=400.
adaptive_locus: Individuals carry mutation parameters chi or phi that are multiplied or divided by A before bit mutation
published_targets: Published phase payoffs and evaluation-budget curves for n=300/400
critical_blocker: No official implementation, seeds, raw runs, or executable environment was located, so the stochastic protocol and published curves cannot be independently replayed.
audit_note: The equations are suitable for a formula-only clean-room study, not an exact published-result verification.

title: Effective Adaptive Mutation Rates for Program Synthesis

title: Local Adaptive Operator Selection in Adaptive Non-Dominated Tournament Genetic Algorithm (A-NTGA) in Solving Multi-Objective NP-Hard Problems With Constraints
affiliation_evidence: Both authors list Wroclaw University of Science and Technology, Poland.
source_revision: 8386298ccbb751ba6a8ad980f94098690c17e892 (last main-branch commit before the 2026-04-29 publication date)
optimization_task: Direct multi-objective constrained scheduling and resource-allocation optimization
dimension_evidence: The selected MS-RCPSP instance 200_40_130_9_D4 has one resource-assignment gene for each of 200 tasks.
adaptive_locus: Per-individual credit memory changes roulette probabilities for selecting mutation operators before each offspring mutation
published_targets: Table 6: A-NTGA average IGD is 0.380 +/- 0.127 in units of 10^-2 on 200_40_130_9_D4 over 30 runs
A-NTGA obtains the best average IGD on 8/15 MS-RCPSP, 15/15 TTP, and 14/16 MSRA instances (37/46 total)
Average IGD reductions versus B-NTGA are 34.57%, 47.17%, and 35.39%
critical_blocker: The paper claims a complete source artifact, but the publication-era configurations select UniformMultiOperator and the factory maps CreditRoulette names to a different selector; source-native execution of the claimed algorithm is therefore impossible without patching.
audit_note: The paper fully specifies the local credit update for a clean-room implementation, but the frozen author artifact decisively fails criterion 10; it also lacks a LICENSE, published seed ledger, and raw 30-run outputs.

title: Adaptive genetic algorithm based deep feature selector for cancer detection in lung histopathological images
affiliation_evidence: A coauthor lists the Institute of Neural Information Processing, Ulm University, Germany.
optimization_task: Direct binary selection of CNN features for classification
dimension_evidence: The GA selects a subset of 128 extracted CNN features.
adaptive_locus: Mutation probability increases linearly from p_min over the 50-iteration run
published_targets: 99.75% accuracy with 22 of 128 features versus 98.95% without feature selection
critical_blocker: The notebook ignores its randomstate argument and seeds from wall-clock time; dependencies, CNN weights, and the 128-D feature matrix are not frozen, and paper/code fitness paths require reconciliation.
